children: What a difference 11 days makes. Nvidia, now the world's third-largest company by market capitalization, as recently as Nov. 6 was the largest.

Nvidia fell to No. 2 the next day and No. 3 Friday. Its market cap Tuesday was $3.74 trillion, about $1.3 trillion behind market leader Apple. It hasn't been that far behind the iPhone maker since January 2024.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
